messages:
maria: Heads-up, tenant 'Axiom' saw a huge host->CPU fault spike during 3pm peak. GPU stalls jumped and p95 latency crossed 200ms. Can we trial transient NUMA-local prefetch priority for them to bring p95 under 120ms? logs: https://logs/axm/1712349876

sunil: Do we actually expose per-tenant staging SLAs today? I thought we only had generic hint buckets. We don't have semantics for guarantees. :thinking:

maria: Correct, not yet. Sketching a design: soft-priority tokens scoped to tenant + numa node with decay and a per-host budget. If budget is exhausted, revert to best-effort prefetch. Goal: avoid global evict thrash and OOM cascades.

olivia: API suggestion: request = { tenant_id, numa_id, priority_level, budget_ms, decay_policy }. Server-side admission module enforces fairness. Must ensure other tenants aren't starved.

jamal: Implementation note: use token-bucket per NUMA node rather than global. NUMA-local staging reduces cross-node copy latency and keeps hot pages local. Example default token config:
```
prefetch_policy:
  tokens_per_min: 100
  burst: 25
  decay_window: 30s
```
This lets tenants burst but decays to steady rate.

sunil: Evictor needs to prefer demoting pages from lower-tier tenants when premium prefetch increases resident set. That implies tagging resident pages with tenant + priority metadata.

maria: Watch out for fragmentation: aggressive prefetching of large fragmented models can bloat staging and fragment pools, hurting throughput. Add fragmentation cap: max_staging_percent_per_tenant (e.g., 25%). On cap hit, downgrade prefetch tokens.

olivia: Observability required: trace token grants -> prefetch hits -> latency delta. Console should emit token burn rate vs p50/p99 improvement and staging_fragmentation metric so SRE/product can evaluate ROI.

infra-bot: deploy queued: branch feature/numa-prefetch -> staging at sha:deafbeef :rocket:

jamal: QA plan: multi-tenant synthetic runs with mixes (many small models vs few huge models). Track metrics: host_compaction_delta, prefetch_hit_ratio, p99_latency, staging_fragmentation. Auto-throttle rule: if compaction_delta > 15% over 5m, reduce token allotment by 50% for the offending tenant.

maria: Also add a contractual option: Dedicated tenants can opt-in for higher guaranteed prefetch at contract time, but still bounded to prevent OOM cascades.

sunil: Keep core allocator contracts unchanged. Implement admission and throttling at the staging controller layer; allocator only needs tagging hooks. Minimizes blast radius.

olivia: Agreed. Keep eviction policies pluggable and controller-driven.

maria: I'll write an RFC today: API payloads, token semantics, fragmentation cap, eviction priority mapping, telemetry, rollout plan (staging -> canary -> gradual ramp). Will ping @sunil @jamal @olivia for review. :thumbsup:

jamal: Ack. I'll add compaction and fragmentation dashboards to the QA checklist.

maria: If no major blockers I want to prototype this week.
